item.tib: khro mchog 'dus pa sde brgyad 'byung po spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las cha lag pad dkar phon po
item.coloph: de dag gsang ba sngags kyi sngon 'gro'i lam/ mchog 'di bdag gzhan lhag bsam dag pa yis/ gsang mchog rta mgrin sgrub pa'i cha rkyen du/ gsang bdag rnal 'byor bdag gi lung gis rab bskul nas/ gsang sems dngos grub thob phyir sa stag lo yi tshes su sbyar/ phyi rabs smin grol 'khod pa'i lam gyur cig/
